The page says this is the V1 Solofil cup but what I received was the V2 cup.  It doesn't work so well for me - I use ground coffee, not some pre-filled pod.  The filter portion is only half of the cup, and if you fill it (like I normally would with the V1 cup) it overflows and clogs the machine.  Even with the filter filled only half way, I strain to get the amount of coffee I dialed up on my Vue.  So while it works, I think it may work better for people who are using coffee pods and not ground coffee. More importantly, label the product pages better!

Item was as just as described and looks and feels to be manufactured very well. Installation was very easy, just push in a twist to lock. Fit like a glove, no problems whatsoever. This is a generic replacement for my Samsung Refrigerator which had an OEM Filter DA29-00020A. I ran a few large cups of water through it and emptied the ice bin. Both the water and ice immediately started tasting better. This filter has solid certifications and is a very economical alternative to the OEM filters which can run over twice the price. I'll definitely be ordering these again next time the warning light comes on.

The water dispenser wouldn't provide water or allow the fridge to make any ice. I initially thought the issue was with the water line. Before doing anything else, I decided to order a new filter (different brand) and replace this one. The dispenser works flawlessly and the ice maker now produces ice.
I guess that means that the filter failed after 2 months of light use. My tap water is municipal, it's not particularly hard, I don't quite understand why the filter would have failed prematurely unless the filter itself was flawed. I haven't had this problem before. I wouldn't recommend this brand.
